All new revisions retain status proposed. Use at most about 550 words per hypothesis, with succinct populated fields. The only one-condition slots should have a descriptive or comparative question with no claimed stock matched control. The stock factory can only freeze a matched condition as one literal body edit or a pure Source-order change preserving the exact Source roster. If proposing volume changes, keep them as separately authorized audit or optional diagnostics and one full-file scored condition. Do not copy wording from existing hypothesis examples.
# Benchmark v3 portfolio research scope

This custodian brief summarises the earlier v3 research specification and its
[packet protocol](../../docs/workflows/benchmark-v3-packets.md) for repeated
development planning. The initial specification defined three independent
Matter histories and eight conditions. A planning round may consider expansion
toward ten independent families. Keep conditions and observations separate
from Matter-family counts.

The benchmark asks whether a single full-context extraction recovers the
complete explicitly supported current Person/Trust graph at a dated meeting
cut-off, attaches the necessary passages to each critical edge, and withholds
named edges left open by the supplied file. Use six existing relationship
types, exact names and quotes, and the frozen v2 evidence policy and same-edge
sufficiency diagnostic. Unresolved questions are recorded by reviewers. The
extractor exposes only its graph and attached evidence for assessment.

Use wholly fictional text-readable Sources grounded in English and Welsh
document conventions. Put the ordinary meeting purpose and cut-off in the
adviser's file. Author documents from participant knowledge, derive the key
independently from the locked documents, audit in both directions, and require
dated human admission. Match variants by predeclaring the single allowed edit,
expected supported difference and unchanged material. Verify sufficiency by
whole-file masks, proper proof-set deletions, exact excerpt readers and
singleton checks. Challenge shortcuts based on dates, file order, first name,
similar-name merger, evidence union, administrative assertions and drafts.
Require a credible purpose and custody path for each record. A verified
contrast establishes a property of the authored file.

The v2 baseline motivated a shift from short, often explicit Sources to
documentary reconstruction. The v3 specification records 97.18% micro-F1
over 18 observations on 14 v2 conditions, a median of two Sources and 123.5
Source-body words, and an incomplete same-edge attachment for the v2 linked
target. A higher word count or lower score does not establish scientific value.
The [frozen v2 study design](https://github.com/alistairkung/private-client-graph/blob/c4a21e5f/benchmark_v2/README.md)
describes the control structure and scoring.

This is a pre-baseline v3 planning profile. Use admitted development technical
findings only. Keep model evaluation results, sealed data, OCR, Source
acquisition, retrieval, legal determinations outside the ontology, estimates
of workload prevalence, and practitioner outcomes outside the planning inputs.


This round supersedes the older ten-families planning target. Propose a scientifically differentiated development allocation of 20 independent histories, allowing a shortfall if a credible incremental question cannot be designed. A/B/C/D/F are the five admitted, 12 conditions, Sources respectively 7/7/7/3/5 per condition. D/F technical findings are limited and formal reconciliation remains pending. E has 2 diagnostic conditions at seven Sources, returned for realism and witness provenance; leave out. H/I/J are three pending reservations from separate pilot, expected Sources 5/5/8, conditions 1/2/2, reasoning intentions described in development findings. Keep these IDs and designs outside proposals. G exists as proposed @1; either revise exact lineage if new marginal purpose survives H, or explicitly defer it and use a fresh ID. Suggested new IDs G and K–U (or K–V if G is held). Target twelve new conditional slots including one giant, without filling with redundant ideas.

Classify measured Source loads distinct from reasoning. Five existing families already fill the initial routine tier; with pilot this mix needs rebalancing. Working volume convention 3–8 routine, 9–20 moderate, 21–50 complex, 51–99 large, 100–200 giant (report reasoning separately). Consider roughly 6 moderate and 4 complex new families, one large and one giant, but follow value. Give explicit nominal Source count, plausible range, numeric sessions, nominal conditions, and workload rationale in each feasibility field. Per-Source authoring is mandatory in the current factory. Core sessions equal Sources + four times conditions + two, plus matched realization if separately counted, section packets for large files, independent evidence checks and repair. For giant core is one 100–200 Source full-file condition, optional unscored scaling diagnostics separately gated. Two independent reading tracks across all sections and whole-file reconciliation, cross-section identity adjudication, checkpoint costs and admission. Fixed graph scaling contrasts workload; evolving history snapshots vary the graph and cut-off. Prior use A 40, B/C 60 combined, D–F 90 combined including returned E, pilot 79 ceiling only. D–F mask jobs 34, authors 21. Estimate low/central/high and phases in portfolio_summary or stopping_criteria. Human admission stays required.

Keep exact-six-predicate ontology and supplied-text boundary. For a causal contrast specify the predeclared measured outcome (edge recall/unsupported named edges/same-edge evidence subset) and disconfirming result, plus a feasible matched manipulation or paired controlled workload comparison. Separate naturally descriptive cases, audit masks, and scored conditions. Aim for mechanisms beyond repeated identifier lookup and certification, meaningful estate/will/kinship diversity, source-origin/count effects, directionally interpretable administrative load and distinct complex cases. Public references ground genres only; clearly label unverified workflow volumes, invented form fields and custody conventions, no prevalence. Avoid scoring estates, executor classes, legal beneficial interest inferred from payment, kinship transitivity, missing legal findings, or unresolved exact homonyms. Specific Person/Trust effects only from explicit records. No fictional participant names, exact narratives, keys or Source examples; no approval or commissioning. Prioritize marginal decisions, costs and rejection criteria in succinct text. Return complete valid contract JSON.
